title: Unlocking the Wealth of the Righteous
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he decrees a year of abundance and blessing over The River Church of Kansas City and its members, calling in financial provision and harvest from the seeds they've sown. In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris teaches on how to receive the wealth of the wicked and live a life of financial freedom, as well as how to contend for the blessings of God with one another in a spirit of gratitude and generosity. Don't miss this inspiring message that will challenge you to trust God's promises and walk in His abundance.
